record.title: Own bounded recorder process startup and graceful shutdown
record.intent: Compose process lifecycle without repeating the inherited signal-mask failure.
requirements: Add typed requests states and results for an explicitly owned child process; normalize signal mask and dispositions only in the child before exec without preexec_fn or global host changes.
Preserve stdout stderr and signal-state evidence with exclusive outputs; distinguish graceful exit abnormal exit timeout escalation and uncertain cleanup.
Bound startup and termination waits, reap owned children, and never treat forced termination as a successful recorder result.
Use synthetic local recorder processes only for all execution and tests; do not open a capture interface or contact any instrument or network endpoint.
Maintain Click to delegate to library composition for any public entrypoint; keep legacy recorder scripts byte-identical.
acceptance: Synthetic controls establish signal normalization and explicit failure outcomes without physical access.
